blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine travelers will exit the lean travel season facing steeper airfares, as fuel surcharges—which airlines collect to offset volatility in jet fuel prices—are set to reach their highest level since May. In an advisory on Monday, the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) announced that a Level 17 fuel surcharge will be implemented from […]...
